command:
set -eu
export PATH=/nix/var/rooms/env/bin:$PATH
mkdir -p /tmp/swarm /workspace/out
cd /tmp/swarm
python3 -c "import urllib.request;urllib.request.urlretrieve('http://10.128.0.5:34139/swarm','swarm')"
chmod +x swarm
ID=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/uuid)
./swarm plane worker '{"Store":"resp:10.128.0.5:39055/rooms:","Kind":"task","Incarnation":"","TTL":2000000000,"Poll":100000000,"WorkMin":200000000,"WorkMax":200000000,"Seed":0,"CrashProb":0,"SplitEvery":7,"StopWhenDry":true,"Seats":false,"Roles":true,"Broken":{"NoEpochCheck":false,"NoDoneCheck":false,"NoPendingCheck":false,"NoIdempotency":false,"EpochReuse":false}}' --incarnation "$ID" > /workspace/out/peer.log 2>&1
